grounding: documents/gcc/final_permit.txt (Part I Section A limitation table, lines 66-74): permit columns marked 'Report' or 'N/A' for TSS 30-day average and dissolved copper align with structured rows that have empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR while sibling columns carry numeric limits (e.g., TSS daily max 50 mg/L).

documents/gcc/fact_sheet.txt (lines 227-233): 30-day-average TSS is report-only monitoring; the enforceable numeric limit is the daily maximum—establishing that an empty-average limit slot coexists with a populated numeric sibling row for the same parameter.

documents/aztec/final_permit.txt (Part I limitation table, lines 78-82): flow, cyanide, and TDS columns are Report-only while TSS carries numeric 20/30 mg/L limits—empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR on Report pollutants is not absence of all numeric limits for the parameter.
documents/aztec/final_permit.txt (footnote *1, line 93): 'When discharging' establishes conditionality for rows whose DMR_COMMENT_TEXT is 'WHEN DISCHARGING.'
documents/farmington/final_permit.txt (Part I limitation table, lines 63-87): flow, TDS discharge/intake, and cadmium 7-day-average columns are Report-only in permit text.
documents/farmington/final_permit.txt (footnotes *6-*7, lines 121-122): geometric-mean reporting semantics for TDS rows referenced in DMR_COMMENT_TEXT.

sources/permit_limits.csv: DMR_COMMENT_TEXT on 12 WET retest rows encodes PASS=0/FAIL=1 non-concentration reporting; all 57 empty-limit rows carry LIMIT_TYPE_CODE='ENF', which does not disambiguate report-only, pass/fail, conditional, or numeric-sibling patterns.
interpretation: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR is not a uniform semantic class. Workspace permit text (gcc, aztec, farmington) establishes that for matched parameters, empty values in report-average or Report-column slots denote report-only monitoring without a numeric concentration limit in that row, while numeric limits may appear on sibling rows for the same parameter. Structured DMR_COMMENT_TEXT on sources/permit_limits.csv establishes a distinct pass/fail (0/1) category on 12 WET retest rows and signals conditional ('WHEN DISCHARGING') or aggregated (geometric mean) obligations on others. However, no single structured field or reusable rule classifies all 57 empty rows: LIMIT_TYPE_CODE is uniformly ENF, LIMIT_VALUE_TYPE_CODE has no workspace codebook, 18/57 rows have blank DMR_COMMENT_TEXT without permit-text cross-check in the packet, and discharge-occurrence evidence needed for conditional rows is absent. The obligation therefore cannot be resolved to one answer (numeric limit, report-only, or a single alternative) across all occurrences.
remaining_uncertainty: Semantic class for 18/57 empty-limit rows with blank DMR_COMMENT_TEXT and no permit-text match in the packet; per-period applicability of WHEN DISCHARGING rows; whether geometric-mean and pass/fail rows should enter numeric comparison at all; whether report-only classification can be mechanically applied from structured fields without per-parameter permit-text linkage.
